speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thou art in the orchard door again. I looked this morning. I did not touch it. Thou saidst thou wouldst not sit.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am looking. I am not sitting. The stone is where I put it back.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Then look, and come in. I am not lighting thee into the apples. Leave the hall as clear as I have made it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sheet stays on the bench. I read it once, this morning. I am not reading it into a better night.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Good. Come up. The eighteenth is not tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am coming. The stone can keep it.
